Pulse for 28 October 2026

The stories from 28 October 2026 in the Pulse of the Sapaude app, in our own words. Terms you don’t know are explained in the glossary. Glossary

Everyday tool

See what AI work achieves

A smart report is a Claude Enterprise review that reads a sample of a team's chats, groups the work, and attaches a cost, and Anthropic says those reports, short in-app surveys, and a shared group budget are generally available.

Everyday tool

Copilot picks the model

Model routing is a system that chooses which program answers a task, and GitHub's changelog on 28 October 2026 says Copilot Fusion, now generally available, asks you for an effort level instead of a model name.

Everyday tool

Chats show the data steps

A data workflow is the ordered path from a messy spreadsheet to a number you would sign, and Prophecy says its new DataGPT builds that path inside ChatGPT, Claude, and Microsoft Copilot.

New model

New AI hunts software holes

Gemini 4 Carbon is a new Google model built to find security holes in software, check whether a hole can really be used, and draft a fix at the cause.

Everyday tool

Each claim keeps its source

An artifact, in this gallery, is an interactive tool such as a tracker or a dashboard inside Claude, and Anthropic says each legal one opens on an example and links every output back to its source.

Everyday tool

A sentence becomes a demo

Replica is an open-source tool from GitHub Design that turns a plain-language idea into a clickable prototype built from your team's own buttons, patterns, and docs.

New model

AI notes who said what

Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is an open model that turns one recorded meeting into a transcript with speaker labels, a translation, or answers about what was decided.

AI agents

Write team chores in words

An agentic workflow is a note in ordinary language that GitHub turns into an automatic job, and on 28 October 2026 GitHub said teams can use that note to hand repeating repository chores to a coding agent.
